info.title: Recap API
info.description:
Contract of the active-recall web application (bachelor thesis). Generated from the Zod schemas
in `backend/src/modules/*/schemas.ts`; do not edit `docs/openapi.json` by hand.

**Conventions**

- Base path `/api/v1`; JSON bodies; `snake_case` field names; integer ids;
  ISO 8601 UTC timestamps; `YYYY-MM-DD` dates.
- Authentication: session JWT (≤ 24 h) in an httpOnly cookie, sent automatically by the browser.
- Collections: `?page=&page_size=` → `{ items, total, page, page_size }`.
- Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`.
- Each operation summary starts with the use cases it serves, e.g. `[UC-04]`.
- Routes answer `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` until their segment is built.

**Error catalogue**

| code | HTTP | message (SRS id) |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Datele trimise nu sunt valide. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | 401 | Sesiunea a expirat sau lipsește. Autentifică-te din nou. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | Nu ai dreptul să faci această acțiune. |
| `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | 403 | Cererea vine de pe un alt site și a fost refuzată. |
| `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` | 429 | Prea multe cereri. Încearcă din nou peste puțin timp. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Resursa cerută nu există. |
| `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Ruta cerută nu există. |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | Acțiunea intră în conflict cu starea curentă a resursei. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Eroare internă a serverului. |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | 501 | Funcționalitatea nu este încă implementată. |
| `INVALID_REGISTRATION_DATA` | 400 | Verifică datele: adresa de e-mail trebuie să fie validă, iar parola să aibă 8–64 de caractere, cu cel puțin o literă și o cifră. (M01) |
| `EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS` | 409 | Există deja un cont cu această adresă. Autentifică-te sau resetează parola. (M02) |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | 401 | E-mailul sau parola sunt greșite. După 5 încercări greșite, autentificarea se blochează 15 minute. (M03) |
| `ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED` | 429 | Prea multe încercări greșite. Autentificarea este blocată temporar. (M03) |
| `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED` | 403 | Contul este blocat de administrator. |
| `RESET_TOKEN_INVALID` | 400 | Linkul de resetare este invalid, expirat sau a fost deja folosit. |
| `PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_FAILED` | 403 | Parola introdusă nu este corectă. |
| `PASSWORD_TOO_LONG` | 400 | Parola este prea lungă: poate avea cel mult 72 de octeți (literele cu diacritice ocupă câte 2). (M01) |
| `SUBJECT_NAME_TAKEN` | 409 | Ai deja o materie cu acest nume. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT` | 415 | Formatul fișierului nu este acceptat. Încarcă un PDF, DOCX sau TXT. (M04) |
| `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | Fișierul depășește limita de dimensiune sau de pagini. Încarcă o variantă mai mică. (M05) |
| `TEXT_NOT_EXTRACTABLE` | 422 | Documentul nu a putut fi citit. Încarcă o versiune în care textul poate fi selectat. (M06) |
| `DAILY_UPLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED` | 429 | Ai atins limita zilnică de încărcări. Revino mâine. (M08) |
| `DOCUMENT_ALREADY_PROCESSING` | 409 | Documentul este deja în procesare. |
| `DOCUMENT_NOT_READY` | 409 | Documentul nu este încă analizat complet. |
| `LLM_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | Serviciul de analiză nu este disponibil acum. Poți continua cu materialele existente; încearcă din nou mai târziu. (M07) |
| `SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED` | 422 | Sursa acestui material nu a putut fi verificată în document. (M09) |
| `CONCEPTS_IN_DIFFERENT_DOCUMENTS` | 409 | Se pot uni numai concepte din același document. |
| `MATERIAL_ALREADY_REPORTED` | 409 | Ai raportat deja acest material. |
| `NOT_ENOUGH_MATERIALS` | 409 | Nu există suficiente materiale verificate pentru acest test. |
| `TEST_ALREADY_FINISHED` | 409 | Testul este deja finalizat. |
| `TEST_NOT_FINISHED` | 409 | Testul nu este încă finalizat. |
| `UNSUBSCRIBE_TOKEN_INVALID` | 400 | Linkul de dezabonare nu este valid. |

Service and database health

post.summary: [UC-01] Create an account and open a session
post.description:
RF1. On success the session cookie is set and the account gets its default preferences. Any invalid field answers `INVALID_REGISTRATION_DATA` (M01) with `details` listing the fields; a password over 72 bytes answers `PASSWORD_TOO_LONG`; an address that already has an account answers `EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS` (M02). Rate limited per IP (`TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`).

Public (no session required).

post.summary: [UC-02] Authenticate with e-mail and password
post.description:
RF2. Sets the session cookie (JWT, ≤ 24 h, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax). Errors: `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (M03, 401) for an unknown address or a wrong password, identically; `ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED` (429) from the 5th consecutive failure and for 15 minutes, with `details.retry_after_seconds` and a `Retry-After` header (C-12, C-17); `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED` (403) only with the correct password; `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` (429) for the per-IP limit.

Public (no session required).

post.summary: [UC-02] Close the session (clears the cookie)
post.description: Requires an authenticated session (any role).

get.summary: [UC-02] Current user and session expiry
get.description:
The frontend calls it on load; `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` means "show D15 Sesiune expirată" (C-11).

Requires an authenticated session (any role).

post.summary: [UC-03] E-mail a password reset link
post.description:
RF2, C-24. Always answers 202, whether or not the address has an account, so that accounts cannot be enumerated. The link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once.

Public (no session required).

post.summary: [UC-03] Set a new password with a reset token
post.description:
On success every existing session of the account stops working and no new session is opened: the user logs in with the new password. Errors: `RESET_TOKEN_INVALID` (unknown, expired or already used token, identically), `PASSWORD_TOO_LONG`.

Public (no session required).

get.summary: [UC-11] Read the preferences of the current user
get.description: Requires an authenticated session (any role).

patch.description:
RF18. Only the fields present in the body change.

Requires an authenticated session (any role).

get.summary: [UC-12] Export own data as JSON or CSV
get.description:
RF20. `format=json` returns one JSON document; `format=csv` returns a ZIP archive with one CSV file per data set.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-12] Delete own account and all its data
post.description:
RF20. Requires the current password. Removes everything from the active database at once and clears the session. Errors: `PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_FAILED`.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-04] List own subjects
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-04] Create a subject
post.description:
RF3. Errors: `SUBJECT_NAME_TAKEN`.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-04] Read a subject
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

patch.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

delete.summary: [UC-04] Delete a subject and everything in it
delete.description:
RF3. Removes its documents, passages, concepts, materials, tests, answers, progress and reviews. The UI confirms first (M10).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-04] Upload a PDF, DOCX or TXT file into a subject
post.description:
RF3, RF4, EV1. `multipart/form-data` with one part named `file`. The document is created with status `queued` and analysed in the background. Errors: `UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT` (M04, 415), `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (M05, 413), `DAILY_UPLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED` (M08, 429). C-03: `details` carries the violated limit.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-04] List own documents
get.description:
RF6. Deleted documents are never returned.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-04] Daily upload quota and current limits
get.description:
C-07: the counter resets at 00:00 Europe/Chisinau.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-04] Read a document and its current status
get.description:
C-02: the frontend polls this route (every ≤ 3 s) while status is `queued` or `processing`.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

patch.description:
RF6, event RD: allowed in every state, does not change the status.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

delete.description:
RF6, event ȘT, EV17. Allowed in every state; a running analysis is cancelled and late results are ignored (C-08). The UI confirms first (M10).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-04] Queue a document for analysis again
post.description:
RF6, event RP: only from `ready` or `error`. Errors: `DOCUMENT_ALREADY_PROCESSING` when it is `queued` or `processing` (C-09).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-04] Download the original file (for the built-in viewer)
get.description:
RF5. The `Content-Type` is the one of the uploaded file.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-04, UC-17] List the passages of a document, in order
get.description:
RF4, RF5. Errors: `DOCUMENT_NOT_READY` while the document is not `ready`.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

parameters.name: page_number
parameters.description: Only passages on this page of the document

get.summary: [UC-05] List concepts of a subject or a document
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-05, UC-17] Add a concept manually
post.description:
RF8. The server checks that every passage belongs to one document of the student (RF9).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-05, UC-17] Read a concept with its verified source passages
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

patch.summary: [UC-05] Rename a concept or edit its definition
patch.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

delete.summary: [UC-05] Delete a concept with its materials and progress
delete.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-05] Merge another concept into this one
post.description:
RF8. Errors: `CONCEPTS_IN_DIFFERENT_DOCUMENTS` when the two concepts are not from the same document (C-22).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-06, UC-17] Generate review materials for concepts of a document
post.description:
RF10, EV6, rules R1–R5. Synchronous: answers when generation and verification are done. Only verified materials are saved and returned (RB1, C-15). Errors: `DOCUMENT_NOT_READY` (409), `LLM_UNAVAILABLE` (M07, 503, after 2 retries — nothing is changed, C-14).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-06] List own materials, filterable
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-06] Read a material
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-06, UC-17] The verified source passage of a material („Sursă” button)
get.description:
RF5, RF9, RF10. Errors: `SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED` (M09).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-06, UC-17] Ask for a new variant of a material
post.description:
RF10 („poate cere o variantă nouă”). Same rules and errors as generation.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-08] Report a material or question as wrong
post.description:
RF10, RF12, EV13, C-19. The material becomes `reported`. Errors: `MATERIAL_ALREADY_REPORTED` (a student reports a material once).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-07] Configure and start a test
post.description:
RF11, RF12. Questions come from verified materials; missing ones are generated. Errors: `NOT_ENOUGH_MATERIALS` (409), `LLM_UNAVAILABLE` (M07, 503 — D10, back to the configuration).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-07] List own tests, newest first
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-07] Read a test with its questions (to resume it)
get.description: Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-07] Answer one question and get feedback
post.description:
RF13, EV7. Each question is answered once. Short answers are evaluated by the model; if it is unavailable the verdict is `unevaluated` (C-04). Errors: `TEST_ALREADY_FINISHED`.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-07] Finish the test: score it, update mastery and reviews
post.description:
RF13, RF14, RF16. The score is returned only when all evaluation is done (C-05). Errors: `TEST_ALREADY_FINISHED`.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

get.summary: [UC-07] Result of a finished test
get.description:
Errors: `TEST_NOT_FINISHED`.

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.summary: [UC-07] Evaluate again the answers left `unevaluated`
post.description:
C-04. Errors: `TEST_NOT_FINISHED` (409), `LLM_UNAVAILABLE` (503).

Requires an authenticated session with role `student`.

post.description:
